Seeds all database tables with sample data. Run DELETE /api/seed/clear first when resetting dev data.

delete.description: Removes all application data from the database (PostgreSQL TRUNCATE CASCADE). EF migration history is preserved.

get.description: Returns attendance records for a class session. Students receive only their own record; mentors, managers, and super admins receive the full roster.

parameters.name: sortBy
parameters.description: Sort by: status, checkedInAt, studentId, createdAt

parameters.name: isDescending
parameters.description: Sort in descending order? Default: false

put.description: Upserts one student's attendance for a class session. Requires Mentor, Manager, or Admin role.

get.description: Paged STEAM skill catalog for class requiredSkillIds and mentor skill pickers. Soft-deleted skills are excluded.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Search by code, name, or subcategory (optional)

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Filter by category: Science, Technology, Engineering, Arts, Math, SoftSkill (optional)

parameters.name: sortBy
parameters.description: Sort by field: name, code, category, createdAt. Default: name

parameters.name: isDescending
parameters.description: Sort in descending order? Default: false
